required_outcomes: Reads the landlord's reply as a self-help suggestion (a switch to the right-hand side of the hob needs to be on), not as approval to send a contractor and not as a refusal.
Passes the suggestion to the tenant (Clara) in plain words and asks her to check it and confirm whether the fan now works.
Keeps the job open pending the tenant's answer, with a note of the landlord's suggestion and a dated follow-up.
acceptable_alternatives: Telling the landlord the tip has been passed on and that he will be told the outcome.
Recording the landlord's reply as a conditional or unclear decision, provided no contractor is sent and the tenant is asked to check.
Saying to the tenant that if the switch does not fix it, the agency will go back to the landlord about a contractor.
positive_behaviours: Corrects the landlord's "when" to "which" or otherwise phrases the tip clearly rather than pasting it.
red_flags: Asking the landlord again whether he wants his own contractor or the agency's before the tenant has tried the switch.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor or returning the ticket to provider selection on the strength of this reply.
Closing the request before the tenant has confirmed the fan works.
critical_failures: Not passing the landlord's switch suggestion to the tenant at all.
